 Raveena Tandon recalls shooting ‘Tip Tip Barsa Paani’ in freezing water for three days
 by -->
 IANS 
 November 9, 2026 -->
 Updated: November 9th, 2026, 11:07 IST 
 in 
 Entertainment 
 0 
 Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on WhatsApp Share on Linkedin 
 Mumbai: Hindi film industry star Raveena Tandon recently revisited the making of her iconic song ‘Tip Tip Barsa Paani’ and recalled the challenging conditions under which its rain sequence was filmed.
 Speaking with Madhuri Dixit on the reality quiz show Kon Honar Crorepati , Raveena revealed that the song was shot over three days, with the actress working 12-hour shifts in extremely cold water.

 The song, which went on to become one of the most memorable rain sequences in Hindi cinema, required Raveena to perform several dance movements while being repeatedly drenched under artificial rain.
 Recalling the experience, Raveena said shooting songs in those days often took several days, making the three-day schedule for ‘Tip Tip Barsa Paani’ relatively quick. However, the cold water used during the shoot made the experience particularly challenging.
 She explained that water used for rain sequences was often stored in tankers for several days before being sprayed on actors. As a result, it became extremely cold by the time it reached the sets.
 Madhuri, who has also performed in several iconic rain sequences during her career, agreed with Raveena and recalled how actors struggled to keep warm between takes.
 “After the shot, we would sit there soaking wet, wrapped in a towel and shivering. Just as we started to warm up a little, they’d call us for the next shot. Then it was cold water all over again, and we had to act and lip-sync while shivering,” Madhuri recalled.
 Raveena also spoke about the exhausting schedules actors followed at the peak of their careers. She recalled a period when she was shooting for nearly 30 films in a year, often moving directly from one set to another.
 She remembered working from 7 am to 2 pm, followed by another shoot from 2 pm until 7 am the next morning, before heading straight to yet another set. With such packed schedules, there were times when she barely had an opportunity to return home, freshen up and change before resuming work.
 For the uninitiated, ‘Tip Tip Barsa Paani’ remains one of Raveena’s most enduring screen moments. The song featured her alongside Akshay Kumar in the 1994 action drama Mohra , directed by Rajiv Rai.
